moat_and_industry.economic_moat_audit: Cupid Limited appears to possess a narrow economic moat primarily driven by intangible assets and high switching costs within its niche. This creates high switching costs for large institutional buyers who prioritize reliability and regulatory compliance. The development of nitrile female condoms, targeting a global monopoly segment, further indicates a strategy to build on specialized product offerings.
